### Post #31: 2024-05-08 02:07

**A FEW TIPS FOR OPTIONS TRADING🧠🧠🧠**

•Buy options in stocks with high liquidity, it gives better spreads and less chances of getting poor fills. 

•Always check the Greeks. Look for low Theta and IV under 50% if you’re swing trading. 

•Don’t go too far OTM. Find stocks that you can afford to hold contracts 3-4 weeks out. 

•Exit most plays at 20% profit or cut at 20%. 
You’ll be surprised how fast 20% can grow an account. Also once your contract loses more than 20% the stock has to work harder  to break even again and produce profits

*Link: https://afterhour.com/RoyaltyTradez/eO8/a-few-tips-for-options-trading*

### Post #130: 2024-05-19 20:39 — `$NVDA, $TQQQ, $SMH, $QQQ`

**$TQQQ and $SMH OPTIONS ARE GREAT💎**

If you’re looking for something to trade with good Greeks and not as pricey then these two are great. $TQQQ mirrors the $QQQ. **$DELL**

Starting the day off with $DELL. First screenshot is what grabbed my attention after the earnings gap down. The price action went straight down to the 5/15 gap up that led to $50 run before earnings. Price accumulated around that $128-$135 price range and formed a Falling Wedge on the daily chart. Second screenshot shows the breakout which transitioned into a triangle pattern. Once it broke out I’m watching for rising support leading to the top of this pattern. The two arrows at the top (one on the left) gave me an idea of where the rejection areas will be so I mirrored them on the right of course for a $30 move up. ### Post #360: 2024-07-31 22:32

**I wanna take a minute to address 3M’s (Money, Market, Mental) Mental Health is a Real Thing. **

I’m taking on a minute to make this post about something that’s overlooked in life and it’s Mental & Emotional Health.  You never know what a person is going thru behind closed doors, which is why we are suppose to be “our brothers keeper” in the trading community because nobody outside of profession, hobby, etc knows what we go thru mentally and emotionally in order to invest the amount of money we do everyday. Each of us have our own reasons for why we decided to step into this world of investing and we all shortly found out how taxing it can be on who we are as a person after the closing bell based on our performance that day or even that week. I’ve been in the market since 2018 and since then I’m a testimony of how the markets have revealed my most inner negative self and disrupted my inner peace affecting relationships with others and living day to day in anxiety because I was on a mission to become rich not knowing it levels to this. Even after I figured out what it took to keep myself grounded while trading, we interact with others that’s still working towards that same goal. My personal discord fell apart after a few years because the person I ran it with had personal problems that flowed over into his decision making in the market and even though he’s STILL at this moment one of the best traders I’ve ever traded with showed me that if you inner self isn’t grounded everything around you can be swayed. Market+Money=Mental and the market moves in a way that is designed to play on a persons irrationality and indecisiveness. My first step was taking ACCOUNTABILITY for the way I handled myself in the market. I’ve taken countless “breaks” to educate myself about market psychology and the pre school basics of trading because I knew if lost more money than I wanted my day was gonna be off. Indicators are too readily available and a lot of ppl didn’t learn to read candlesticks or structure, you’ll be surprised how far those two will take you. Secondly, know how much you can tolerate to lose in the market. Yea you might be a little pissed but blowing account can have you on f* the world type of time. Third, find a circle of traders you can vibe with. That becomes your support system, like I said no one knows what we go thru as traders but another trader. Whether you follow somebody for free or buying them a cup of coffee….who gives a 💩….find a mentor/group that speaks your language. You’re gonna either pay for education somehow or pay your tuition to the market. It’s too many tools, books, etc available to traders to help us become better EDUCATED instead of throwing away money trynna make a quick come up. Protect your inner self and inner peace. If you’re an aspiring analyst, leaders don’t choose themselves, the ppl do because they want to survive. If your trying to force yourself in a leadership role before you’re ready, you’re only going to hurt yourself, along with the ppl that’s deciding to give you their peace of mind. 1….let alone 100’s of ppl depending on you to grow their account on top of yours is a BIG RESPONSIBILITY.  Overall, you become a better trader when you learn your weakest flaws and learn how to engage with the market without severely triggering them. You are the secreT indicator in the market because overall YOU HAVE TO MAKE EDUCATED DECISIONS IN WAYS THAT KEEPS YOU IN YOUR COMFORT ZONE.  I hope this resonates with some of you and shows you that it’s okay to sit on the sidelines and gather yourselves, star athletes do it every day because the game is 90% mental and 10% physical. That’s comes with knowledge of self and knowledge in the market. 💯 

*Link: https://afterhour.com/RoyaltyTradez/gID/i-wanna-take-a-minute-to-addre*

### Post #397: 2024-08-14 15:52

**Just something to reflect on if you’re struggling to know when to cut your losses **

Profit recovery charts are very helpful. This is why it’s always important to have a SL in place just case a trade doesn’t go your way. After 35% as you can see, your trades really starts to work harder to get you back into break even and back into profits. It’s important to have strike prices within an attainable range and with enough time on the expiration dates. Always do a delta/theta  spread check to make sure that the Theta isn’t over shadowing your Delta that could further contribute to a losing position. Just thought to drop a little gem for new traders looking trading improvements and develop more disciplined habits in the market💯

*Link: https://afterhour.com/RoyaltyTradez/gYk/just-something-to-reflect-on-i*

### Post #402: 2024-08-19 22:07

**Which Trader Are You?🫵🏾**

Here’s another visual to add to your daily trading plan…set a daily goal for the day and stick to it until your risk tolerance increases. Profit taking is another psychological trigger that a lot of new traders have a tendency to struggle with in an attempt to grow a portfolio. One thing I teach new traders is to choose a daily goal and set a Sell Limit Order to take profit once that goal triggers to avoid having to consciously make that decision on your own. You can’t lose profits if the decision is made for you meanwhile your trading becomes more automated and you’re not trying to hit the home run with every trade. So new traders, focus on your goals and plz do not try to simulate profits from someone that’s been trading for years because blown accounts can happen in a matter of minutes. Find your sweet spot for attainable profits and honestly you shouldn’t risk no more than 10% of your portfolio a day. Let’s start the week off with some positive vibes and a game plan as we go into the remainder of the week. Remember we’re all here for the same thing…to get the money out market at any means necessary 🫡

*Link: https://afterhour.com/RoyaltyTradez/g5C/which-trader-are-you*

### Post #416: 2024-08-26 01:40 — `$AMD` `[Dd]`

**Looks take a look a Trading Strategy using ChoCH and BOS**

Change of Character and Break of Structure are two things that I pay attention when trading chart patterns and market structure because they are both indicators of trend reversals and trend continuations. As you can see I have $AMD 2hr chart up that shows both structure changes on the chart. The first thing you want to look for is the ChoCH that could indicate a trend reversal on a stock, this works well In confluence with other indicators but I like to use simple support and resistance to make entries on the price action on the dip or pump before it continues in the desired trend. Once the price action makes a confirmation move in the direction of the original ChoCH, now you’re looking for the Break of Structure. BOS now gives you the confirmation to hold a play into profits while watching for higher lows and higher highs or vice versa for a downtrend. This is a fairly easy strategy to get into swing plays and bigger timeframes allows you to see more solid confirmation on trend directions while scaling down on your frames to make more precise entries. The simpler the charts the better view you have of trend directions long term. This is just one of many styles of trading. Hope this can some light and give someone something to add to their arsenal this week. 

*Link: https://afterhour.com/RoyaltyTradez/hho/looks-take-a-look-a-trading-st*

### Post #425: 2024-08-27 21:22 — `$CEVA`

**Trading terminology for today is Supply and Demand $CEVA**

If you’re new to the market, two words you may hear being used is Supply and Demand. Pretty much it’s another word to describe Support and Resistance. If we take a look at $CEVA on the Daily chart you can see that it trades sideways in big movement’s between $21.75 & $18.25. You can easily rotate profits in both directions trading options if you identify stocks trading in a big consolidated movement up and down. Majority of the times it’s going to be stocks that’s awaiting news that will dictate the future trend. In CEVA case once it broke Demand levels which should trigger your SL for calls, there was a further movement down before earnings. Once the earnings report was released, the price action moved back into the consolidation zone and moved above the Demand zone which triggers SL for puts and continued to push higher. Every little bit of information helps when reading the market. Add another strategy to your arsenal and use it to capitalize on your gains 💪🏾👑

*Link: https://afterhour.com/RoyaltyTradez/hkE/trading-terminology-for-today-*

### Post #572: 2024-09-30 21:42 `[Discuss]`

**Trading Tip For Today**

If you’ve been following for a min then you prob already know but for a lot of the new traders here on Afterhours, I like to drop 💎 here and there. Here’s one for today…trading the market using time intervals. A lot of times you’ll read my Pre Market Analysis and I’ll tell everyone to let the market digest data and allow for the market to show you the trend. Today for example was just a sideways mudhole for the most part😂😂😂. Learning time frames to trade helps with your discipline as well as increasing your trading IQ. Very rarely are you going to see me call more than 3 trades a day, I’m watching price action after opening bell and giving the market time to show me if I can trust my charts. If everything lines up I take entries leading up to the lunch hours and with a clear target to exit in order to avoid holding too long and maximize profits. If you’re swing trading then at times you may have to hold plays until the “directional” time frame plays out because the first 45 mins of the market being open is normally the most volatile. Small things like this can help you time you entries and help you make better decisions on entries and exits.💯

*Link: https://afterhour.com/RoyaltyTradez/h4P/trading-tip-for-today*

### Post #595: 2024-10-02 23:58

**Trading Tip For The Day**

One of my favorites…Loss Recovery Table. Ever wonder why some contracts are so expensive??? You gotta pay for quality Greeks Fam💰💰💰. Imo, you’re paying to keep Theta decay in check but that’s a diff lesson. This shows you how much your stocks price action has to recover once the trade goes against you. So once you’re down 25% or more on a contract the price action will need move enough in the right direction, on top of over performing to get you back to break even and then more to see profits. 50% or below, definitely cut the contract fam….and if you’re swinging a weekly🤦🏽‍♂️you pay taxes just for holding it overnight. So this is why it’s important to have a SL in place and know the direction of the trend. The more the trade goes against you, the more that stock has to work to get you your money, and if it’s working on a short timescale swinging it can really drain your pockets. Let me know how you feel about this….is this something that may help in your decision making in the market??? I hope so 💯

*Link: https://afterhour.com/RoyaltyTradez/ibb/trading-tip-for-the-day*

### Post #601: 2024-10-04 02:02 — `$TSLA`

**$TSLA Has Crumbled🩸 How I take an Options Trade💯**

As you can see we’re just about at the bottom of this sell off after watching it all unfold with me🩸🩸. It’s approaching the bottom of 09/20/24 support levels. It’s going to need this last level to hold or there could be some more unraveling. Looking at my charts, where you see the different boxes overlap on the way back up…..consider that resistance with the possibility to become support.  If it does indeed become support then the next color box will be its next levels or resistance. This is how I choose my strike prices for options contracts, find how much I’m willing to pay, and find the best contract with a good delta/ratio (normally Delta outweighs the Theta).  I’m also looking for vol/open interest over 1k for quicker fills on entries/exits/SL triggers. Low volume contracts typically give’s extremely slow fills and even longer sell orders!!!!  A lot right 😂😂😂😂 This is the thought process I go thru every time I enter a trade….I need to be able to tolerate the loss and also have an idea when I want to exit before I even enter. Both Greed & Panic only takes seconds to kick in, so I maintain a plan to exit trades before either kicks in. Trading becomes less stressful when you know the risk and reward before you even get started. Here’s a little insight into my psychology and emotion when I take trades. You become a better trader when you take out human emotions when trading options.  

*Link: https://afterhour.com/RoyaltyTradez/ieh/dollartsla-has-crumbled-how-i-*

### Post #619: 2024-10-10 22:50

**It’s been a week of Reflection for me 💯**

Ima hustler, plain and simple. I’m from Louisiana where we have an amazing culture of our own, a failing educational system, and southern hospitality. Trading for me started off as a side hustle in 2018. Didn’t know a damn thing about stocks…where I come from that type work is unheard of. I paid for discords, some good (but too fast) and some scams from mfs who can’t read price action and just have money to blow and claim bangers when one finally hits 😂😂. Growing up in streets of Louisiana showed me that I have a gift of discernment when it comes to reading ppl, situations, and now trading stocks. Everything isn’t always as it seems so you have to be able to look past what’s shown to you in life. Anyways I became self taught and eventually started calling signals in my own discord. I had the same vision as most analysts to give signals, make money, and let others stroke my ego. Jan 2022, i lost my younger cousin to gun violence. Damn what does that have to do with you as a trader??? S/O to my big cousins because they let me be in the trenches just enough to know what it feels like get your own but keep me away from it enough to the point I didn’t become a product…. so I did the same. He had the same mental drive as me but because we were in two diff cities I couldn’t always keep eyes on him. I introduced him to stocks and I wanted to give him an opportunity to make some diff type of money even tho he had a record…I’ve always been a keeper of my bloodline. He was excited the more we talked and the more I started teaching him, So our dream was for us to be the Batman and Robin of trading and we both would have a story to tell. Our last convo was a FaceTime a week before I was going to bring him to town to get him away from the streets for a bit only to wake up to a phone call that the streets took him away from us. That’s a void that still hasn’t been filled and I struggled taking it in because “what if I had got him into trading and away from the streets a little earlier”. Along with some head bumping with my discord partner…I kinda lost some of my 🔥and dissolved the discord. I eventually found a new purpose and it’s to be an advocate for ppl that come from the life i came from. I’m not a full time trader because I don’t have the desire too right now, I have an amazing job with the post office, a full understanding of the stock market and able to make money from it, and now I can help ppl understand how to use the market as an opportunity to do something diff. Although the market is just as unforgiving as the life I grew up in and lived by…it’s a way to survive it and I do my best to show others how. I teach ppl how to trade the market in honor of my Batman and Robin dream because me and him shared that at one point to do this together. So yea I’m where I am today because I kept learning so that the next person that tells me that they wanna learn, I feel like I need to be able to teach at a level efficient enough to make sense to someone at a rate that could change there financial situation. I don’t have a gimmick, I don’t do this for fun, I do this help change someone’s financial situation because I’ve learned this shit out of survival and out of purpose. This is only a chapter of my journey and I have a role to uphold for ppl that has no clue the market even exists. 💯

*Link: https://afterhour.com/RoyaltyTradez/iv2/its-been-a-week-of-reflection-*

### Post #624: 2024-10-12 00:40

**Mentoring is a my Passion**

I got an opportunity this week to do something that I haven’t been able to do in a while this week. I was able to give one of my mentees that’s been consistent in his learning process 1 on 1 attention the entire week!!!  Once again, something I didn’t have the opportunity to have starting off. It’s kinda like growing up and never having something in your life but now that you have it you wanna make sure ya kids, spouse, or whoever doesn’t go without the way you did. We did live entry and exit trades, while I explained what was happening and how I decipher thru the process the entire time. The moment a trader gets the light bulb and starts to “get it”….being able to navigate the market under your own will feels 10x better than just making money because from the mental aspect, understanding the market and risk management builds confidence in your ability to enter and exit trades. Cutting losses and take profits becomes so much easier when you’re not contained by the PDT rule and from a psychological perspective most traders hold on to trades too long because they’re attempting to squeeze out every penny out of their trade instead of taking consistent gains. 25k comes faster than you expect once you become a disciplined trader. EDUCATION and KNOWLEDGE is your key…how bad do you want success though and what are you doing to invest not only financially but mentally as well. Meditation goes a long way in life and some live life too fast to stop and ask ourselves why and how are we setting ourselves up for success. Let this sink in over the weekend while we take our weekend off from the market💯

### Post #693: 2024-10-24 00:31 — `$XOM`

**Understanding how to time the market⏰**

If you’ve been apart of AH for a while then you’ve seen this so let it be a refresher… if you’re new to me and the way I do things then I present opportunities to improve trading psychology and trading discipline. Here’s my gem for tonight….the market moves in a timed fashion and if you pay attention just close enough you can almost keep the market on a timed schedule. My job as a mail carrier is very demanding so I’m not able to constantly watch charts. I have alarms for 9:25, 11:45, 1:00, & 2:30 CST where I’m expecting the market to approach different trading cycles. Trading options straight outta the gates are super dangerous for a few reasons. First, the market is extremely volatile the first 30-45 mins. Some contracts don’t even have the appropriate volume and the spreads are crazy far apart and that increases the chances of you opening an options contract in the red and getting a bad fill. I had a trader swing $XOM puts with me once and he was confused because the profits didn’t change even tho we were deep ITM. I let him know that it’ll take a min for the volume to kick in and 5 min later 💰💰 contracts were printing. Second, it’s hard to dictate the trend during that time also….some days I may not enter a trade until 10:30 CST. The market counts on you to be impatient, irrational, and anxious. The more you understand the mechanics of the market the easier it is to decrease your chances of making mistakes. I like to take profit on plays between 1:00 and 2:30 because IMO you get a brief trend continuation and then a sympathy reversal like we saw going into close today. This is one of many moving parts that’s underrated in options trading which is why I’ve decided to repost and bring to attention. Have anyone else experienced this and if so has it helped you on your decision making?

*Link: https://afterhour.com/RoyaltyTradez/ja3/understanding-how-to-time-the-*

### Post #698: 2024-10-24 22:34 — `$NVDA`

**How’s Your Mental? 🧠**

I know the week is almost over and the market is pretty tough to trade during this rollercoaster ride…so I’m here to ask everyone how are you doing mentally?? Have you had a bad week or two and paralysis by analysis has kicked in or maybe you’re new in the game and your not sure how to enter or what signal to take or how long should I hold this???  There’s signs of mental fatigue and mental stress when handling trades in the market. Start being conscious of what your heart does as soon as you get that confirmation order on a call or put. Be aware of your breathing when p/l starts moving up and down and notice whether you start to get anxious or not. Knowing why you’re entering a trade, having a safety net and exit plan helps with that. If you find yourself second guessing yourself constantly, then there’s more work to be done in the learning aspect. There’s gonna be times where you’re just not set up mentally for taking a trade because the market is merely just a piece of your daily life. But having a good foundation and understanding of why and what you’re trading helps create longevity in the way you navigate the market. We all take losses…hell I took one today on $NVDA and watched my contract get chipped away at for almost 3hrs until my 20% SL triggered when it literally stayed within a $1 range all day but I was prepared for that from opening bell. Everybody mental capacity is diff and it’s up to you to know when to walk away, lock the screen, and find something else to do until you’re ready to get back up and try again. I really enjoy music…I have a deep understanding of how different frequencies affect your brain and energy. So when I find myself getting impatient or can’t find a trade then that’s what I turn too until I’m ready to check charts again. Take care of your mental and mental will help you make better decisions. Reach out to another trader and let them be a shoulder you can lean for a min…shidd reach out to me, I’m all ears most of the time. But continue surrounding yourself with positivity when your mood is affected, it’s ok to be alone at times but it’s nothing like coming back and having a family or community help you get back on your feet. DO NOT LET THIS MARKET STRESS YOU TF OUT!!! 

*Link: https://afterhour.com/RoyaltyTradez/jfk/hows-your-mental*

### Post #758: 2024-11-06 02:45 — `$META, $LLY, $MSTR`

**Trading Options isn’t hard we’re just Impatient**

Interacting with a lot of beginner-intermediate traders, majority of them have one thing in common….trying to make too much money, too quick, and in the least amount of time possible. 🤔🤔🤔 Where I come from (318) you normally catch a charge doing things that makes you rich quick 😂. But a lot of traders attempt trades that are out of there portfolio bracket and blow accounts weekly. Options are meant to be traded like a buy hold imo. Day trading is meant for people that are able identify intra day trends and add buying power for bigger trades. Swing trading 3-6 months out…quarter to quarter is how I originally became successful at trading and developed patience. It’s no way a trader with a $1500-$3000 account should be trading $META, $MSTR, or $LLY. There’s no way a port that size can safely buy options on tickers like that because you’ll have to go too far OTM to maintain proper risk management. If you’re growing an account stick with $$25-$75 stocks that have a high volume options chain and buy longer dated contracts for less money and have more buying power to avg down when you need too. Good companies are going to go back up. Do the research, study the options chain along with the Greeks and grow your account the right way. I yolo plays here and there but it’s never nothing that I can’t afford to lose. The profits I make from day 1 becomes the money I continue to trade with thru out the week. That’s the only way I’m willing to risk more than 20% on a trade because In reality you can’t lose your money only risking profits. Trading becomes diff when you’re able to buy Leap contracts on a stocks and watch the money move on Green Days. All this to say if you’re struggling keeping your account afloat….reevaluate the stocks that you’re trading and be realistic and ask yourself am I putting my portfolio at risk of going to $0 if I buy this option. Swing trading good companies at least 3 months out does wonders for a portfolio faster than you’ll expect  100 

*Link: https://afterhour.com/RoyaltyTradez/jWK/trading-options-isnt-hard-were*

### Post #781: 2024-11-12 04:21 — `$SPY, $QQQ, $BTC`

**What do I look for in the Pre Market✍🏾✍🏾. Here you go💎**

Was answering a question on one of my past posts so I’ll fill you in 

-I’m looking a the sentiment of the Mag7 stocks & ETFs. Looking to see how many are green & red, it lets me know if the markets looking mixed or not. 

-If it’s mixed, I’m looking to see if it’s a certain sector that’s weak or whether certain stocks are inversing or dragging/ pumping the market and ETFs. 

-I look at $BTC since it correlates with tech imo…does it look super, weak, or consolidated. 

-I’m watching to see how closely $QQQ & $SPY price action is in correlation. They both move in $4-5 increments up and down on a normal trending day. 

-Looking to see if there’s a possibility a supply or demand gap once the market opens to help confirm the direction of the trend. Green gaps should be bought and red gaps should be shorted. If neither happens play price action look for trends on bigger time frame. 

-Lastly I’m looking at the market structure on a Daily timeframe to see how the previous candles closed. Checking the opening and closing prices to help determine support and resistance levels. 

These are my major decision makers when analyzing the market for the day. You actually inverse the order of it and make it easier….I just do it that way to give myself a challenge and see if my last check on the daily gives me confirmation. Of course they’re other things that I look for that just came with time and experience that I can’t teach. But this could help in setting up your own Gameplan in the mornings and give you some confidence in following your TA. 💯


*Link: https://afterhour.com/RoyaltyTradez/kzJ/what-do-i-look-for-in-the-pre-*

### Post #874: 2024-12-17 02:34 — `$NVDA, $XOM, $RXRX`

**Identifying a Downtrend Using $NVDA, $XOM & $RXRX**

Here’s examples of ways to identify downtrends in the market. Each one of these charts can clearly find a few of my favorite downtrend indicators. 

-$NVDA shows a descending channel. So what you would use in confluence with the channel is Highs & Lows and also Support Levels. Now in order to confirm a breakout I would use the M.A crossover (daily) + the Fibonacci levels (looking for the golden pocket on the daily) when looking for a breakout outside of the the descending channel. 

-$RXRX has been in a long term downtrend since 2022. Stocks like these sends me to longer timeframes to see the structure and where are moving averages on bigger scale. If you check out the monthly timeframe it constantly rejects at the 34 & 50 EMA. Seeing a disruption and a candle build above those moving average in confluence with a M.A crossover (8,21,34,50,200) gives more confidence of a long term reversal. 

-$XOM we see a clear M.A crossover on the 4hr or the “death cross”where the 50 crosses the 200. In order to trade this to the upside I would use continue to find the 200 moving average on larger timeframes to find a level of support along with Fibonacci levels to give another confirmation on a strong uptrend on the Daily above the 23% and 50% fibs and a load between the 50% & 61.8% area for a continuation to the upside.  

Here’s just a few ways to trade the market and tonight I just wanted to show some trading tips on how to navigate downtrends and what to look for when trading them to the upside. Hope this helps someone 💯

### Post #913: 2024-12-28 21:35 — `$SPY`

**Here’s two scenarios that could play out on $SPY**

Here’s two scenarios that could happen on $SPY next week. Listen up class 😂😂. Here’s two scenarios that can play out with $SPY from what I see. Healthy price action moves in 45 degree angles up and down so that’s how I measure out where prices should be by a certain timeframe (not 100% accurate but it helps for visuals). Next, I use old consolidated periods on the charts to pinpoint where the rejection and support should be and map it out to the current trading period. Historical data also isn’t 100% accurate but it gives you an idea. 

1st rejection is around $600 to $603. This is where puts can be re-entered given this is where the price imbalance is and where the bears are probably looking to step in. Above $603 is what I call an exhaustion zone where prices tend to rollover back to the downside and retest the lows or support of that larger consolidated area which is around $585-584. 

2nd scenario is that the $600 level flips from resistance to support and continues to push the the upside to squeeze out the bears and retest the $608 area. If the market doesn’t make a new gap up to create a demand or bullish gap above $600 then prices will more than likely exhaust at the top of the second highlighted area and come back down to retest the $603 level to see whether it’s solid enough for bulls to step in or if prices needs to come lower to find more buyers before attempting another run. 

Hopes this helps explain the cycle a little better at @radiohead💯

### Post #1095: 2025-03-15 16:31

**Here’s an old Upload but very useful for choosing Option Strike Prices🫡**

It’s prob time for me to redo this video and prob do it live so I can take questions real time, but here’s some studying and homework for the new traders while the market is down. Go thru your charts after the video and find long term strike prices for your fav stocks. Journal the price levels you like, see which way the momentum is currently which is prob down at the moment 🤦🏽‍♂️ and write down the strike prices on the way back up. Find long dated contracts with high open interest (over 1k) and the longer out the expiration the lower the volume might be based on which ticker and look at the bid/ask spread to make sure they aren’t tremendously far apart. The closer they are the better fills you get on entries and exits. This should help you new guys getting into options trading determine what levels to watch in the market long term. Hope you guys have a solid Saturday. Let me know if you have any questions 🫡

https://youtu.be/ZN-fYroHfvs?si=AHfoo9ESemYyHl0k

### Post #1096: 2025-03-15 20:16 — `$VXX, $MRNA, $JNUG`

**Story time w/RoyaltyTradez: How did I find the Stock Market**

What’s good family🫡 I know it’s a lot of new traders that’s starting off on there trading journey and I know that the market can be discouraging at times in the beginning when you’re learning a ton of stuff from picking a brokerage, to learning what stocks to watch, on top of ton of indicators to choose from. Everybody’s path is different and just here to tell you to build healthy relationships along the way. You’re gonna need some support some days 😮‍💨. Learn how options contracts work, learn the BASICS before adding indicators, and surround yourself with a group of traders ranging from ppl on your level, a lil more advanced, and solid mentors. I started trading in 2020 after watching a YouTuber talk about pandemic money and the “Greatest Transfer of Wealth” so started buying $JNUG, $VXX, & $MRNA. Went straight to moving averages and parabolic SAR indicators and it was off to the races. Started off buying 1 share at a time taking a few dollar profits which is the way in my opinion, the safest way to start off a trading journey. After feeling comfortable I joined a options group by the name of Aristotle Trading Group where I actually saw different styles of trading styles, amazing profits🤩, day/swing/leaps, small accounts challenges….a whole new world that I couldn’t keep up with while paying $100/month…Ive always made decent money at the post office but I gotta family to feed and funneling money into an account every week wasn’t an option, so I needed to study a little more in order to keep up with what was happening. Fun fact: some of the traders I watched when I started and thought were amazing…I’m now cool af wit em today and I think that’s pretty dope looking back at it. But it’s baby steps to learning this stuff and the correct education would’ve saved me a lot of confusion. So I started reading tons of trading books to learn this stuff inside and out until I at least knew the basics of what I’m getting myself into and be more in control of my money.

### Post #1130: 2025-04-02 01:12 — `$AAPL`

**Beginner Options Trader Strategy 🫡**

Having a good week so far with the family with one loss today on $AAPL for now and looks like more ppl are comfortable risking contracts between $100-$200 (weekly or +2dte) with a 20-25% SL. This is good for beginner options traders and traders looking to get there confidence back after a large loss.  These size contracts normally risk anywhere from $20-$35 per trade and should allow you to take more than one entry if you’re trading along with the daily/weekly direction. They’re not swing friendly because of the high theta and it being OTM but in this market you’re getting 1-3 days of consistent price levels since the market isn’t holding trends well. So if you’re just hopping into options trading or just need a couple of small wins under your belt…try this out and see if this can become a confidence builder for you on your options journey.🫡 See you guys in the morning 💰

This month makes a year that I’ve been on this app and from the time I’ve been here I’ve been all about the middle class traders/investors. Hell, I’m a mailman that likes to trade 🤷🏽‍♂️ it’s nothing rich about me I just put in a ton of hours in to understand trading mechanics and I try to help where I can. 

This market has been crazy this year…prob one of the craziest years I’ve seen in a while. Whether you’re a new trader or seasoned, the market is doing exactly what is purpose right now and it to get you out of position and have you fearful to put money in. I’ve been watching traders step away left and right because the market is punching them in face and reality is setting in to the point ppl are financially exhausted. I treat trading like a sport because I’ve always had a competitive nature and that always kept me on my toes in whatever I took part in. Brain training is a real thing just like muscle memory and when you’re continuously doing the same thing everyday, while tweaking your methods to improve then eventually you start to sync with whatever it is you’re doing. Nobody in this game is 100% right but the success takes place on how fast and clear are you able to recognize transitions from one direction to another. ### Post #1224: 2025-06-14 17:31 — `$MSTY, $TSLY, $AIYY, $WNTR`

**Yieldmax ETF Strategy 🤔**

What’s good Royal Fam🫡 and Happy Saturday. Hope everybody vibing and locking in as we head into Fathers Day tom so shoutout to all the dads here because trust me…it is a task😂. Lately I’ve been trying to put together a Yieldmax div strategy for The Kingdom follow just so everybody can have some type of weekly payouts to build ports without having to put a whole lot of thought into and it’s coming along so far. 

The goal is to have and hold approach to buying diff ETFs and good support levels and enough shares to automatically buy the dips if it happens to drop lower. The key is to only DRIP the payouts until the shares DCA goes back green then we’ll reinvest those dividends into another YM ETF and build another buy and hold until we’re getting a payout from YM every Friday. 

EX. We bought $AIYY  at $4.79 and it paid .32/share and I bought 208 shares. So I got a payout of $66 and DRIP back into it at $4.52. I’m good with that because now it’s at 4.16 and I have a support level at $3.75. I plan on letting the divs accumulate on DRIP until the DCA is green which shouldn’t take long unless I buy the dip before the next payout and just reap the next div payout to reinvest in something else. 

We bought $TSLY before this weeks rip because it’s an alternating payout from $AIYY and the div payout dropped from .78 to .40 which ok because we’re still up for the moment from the purchase at $8.06. If it goes back below that then guess what…💧. 

So far I’ve taken the time out to chart all the YM stocks to funnel money into a build a YM portfolio. It’s gonna be an interesting journey if it all goes well and have a nice stress free payout at the end of each week once wheel gets started. 

Here’s a few charts outta 40 tickers but I’m putting together the puzzle pieces to the game like no other. Heavy in $MSTY …. then go $WNTR (MSTR short) just paid $3 last payout and $2.71 the week before that. You could use that higher payout to reinvest into $MSTY that’s been paying out the lower payouts until it recovers. 

Let’s see how this journey goes 🫡

*Link: https://afterhour.com/RoyaltyTradez/Qv0/yieldmax-etf-strategy*

### Post #1257: 2025-06-28 20:01

**Here’s My Personal Take On Trading Futures🫡**

Wassup Royal Family 🫡🫡🫡. I’ve finally decided to jump back into the futures market over the past weeks and it’s taken a lil while to get back used to. Which prop firm, which tickers, micros vs minis🤷🏽‍♂️ a headache maybe 😂. 

It’s been a smooth transition tho…I’ve dealt with apex in the past but I decided to go with Topstep this time and Topstep X is pretty dope. Now I have a 50k & a 150k. Honestly, don’t be cheap and pay for 150k fam….$4500 loss limit & a 9K profit target. By the time you get done wrestling and resetting 50k (which I did have to with the first account) the 150k would’ve been paid for. 

The bigger account is just stress free with room for error. You can trade CL all day and not have to worry about the losses going overboard. I personally trade NQ, but I’ve scalped CL and GC just to sprinkle on $100 at a time. Easiest way for me to trade these accounts is have a starter position with 1 buy/sell and then pyramid on top of it (1-3-5) and wait for the slingshot 💰 and I’m out. I set a limit order on all entries and without the pain of dealing with theta decay it works out beautifully. 

Of course everyone has their own way to trade it but I think I found out which way works best for me so…I’m interested in trying BluSky and Take Profit next and see how there daily payouts works eventually. 

Which Futures platform do you guys prefer or using tho?🤔

### Post #1283: 2025-07-05 19:13

**Analysis Paralysis 😵‍💫**

What’s good Royal Family 🫡. A lil topic I just wanted to draw attention to for a min…it’s something I’ve dealt with and something I know a lot new traders deal with constantly. Too much of anything isn’t healthy for you, even too much information being thrown at you can cause this.  

If you’re new to the market and learning how to trade then I always say, find ONE strategy and learn it inside out and make money from it instead of 10 diff ones at once to try and make a highly probability decision. If you’re attempting to learn from someone then stick to that style of trading that they’re teaching until you see how it works. 

Even on charts🤯 too much TA can sometimes force you to second guess your trades and constantly cause you to miss out on massive gains. Simplicity to me is the best chart to look at. Most of my charts are horizontal lines that I determine where the support and resistance is on larger frames. 

So if you’re struggling in the market or TA sometimes it’s best to go back to the basics and rebuild. Find your foundation and get back balanced and build your confidence back💯. Don’t let an over clocked way of thinking be your worst enemy because it doesn’t have to. Eliminate the emotions, find your balance, and execute🫡

*Link: https://afterhour.com/RoyaltyTradez/SgJ/analysis-paralysis*

### Post #1332: 2025-07-22 03:19

**Let’s Talk About Pressure 💎**

Being under pressure has the ability to crush and crumble an object into nothingness.....or it could put something under so much pressure that it becomes something rare and unique.  Pressure was taking hard earned money and putting into the stock market without knowing what tf you're really doing, knowing bills had to be paid but being determined to learn the market because it could be life changing.

Pressure can have you feeling like you're drowning in life, folding under certain situations....giving up and deciding this is your last breath because its just easier.  Imagine being too stubborn to accept that the odds are against you so you make every grasp of air count to keep fighting. It was a point in my trading journey I was door dashing after work just too make extra money to trade with.  Pressure is what's made me fearless and it'll make anyone that continues their journey fearless because experiences are PRICELESS.

Pressure is giving trade alerts too new ppl everyday for years....Because they're counting on the alert to be more right more than wrong. Pressure is jumping on Youtube live alone and having nobody to teach you the ropes, you're just winging it as you go and also trying creating a trading space that's healthy, self sustainable, educational and worth someone's time.

I created The Kingdom based off the personal pressures I've dealt with and fought thru. My experiences are why I operate the way that I do and able to empathize and relate with others that's feeling that pressure. I've met some amazing ppl thats reached out when they saw swimming a little sluggish....at times they've came together to let me piggyback until I got my strength back to continue building this foundation.

@TradeWithCash @aaplbottomjeans @Sambo_Trades @FridgeFinancials @trynamakeit @NewFishBigPond @mygreenknight @PORUNGA @CarlyBme @Dacubemastr 

I appreciate you guys for being around when the pressure was taking a toll. Whether you knew it or not... each of you guys stepped in when I felt the walls closing in and helped me fight back. That is why I'll never stop creating new opportunities for growth in this space when I see an opportunity because Loyalty breed Loyalty.

If you're feeling pressure I'm here to say dont you dare cave in to it.  Give every second hell and fight to stay afloat because if I see you just know I'm coming with the rescue boat and now I'm bringing every resource I have with me.  I didnt know what the stock market was until I was 29 years old (35 now), had no clue how valuable it was because its wasnt something that was  "important" where I'm from....so if I can make it ANYBODY CAN. 

Idk why I'm up typing this but Pressure is what makes you stronger...its whats gone make you....You
I

**Do what works for you💯**

Whats good Royal Fam🫡 I know alot of traders are have been having an exhausting time keeping consistent wins over the past week or so....its a season for everything is all ima say.  You just have to become wise enough to be disciplined to weather thru harsh market conditions. Be able to have rules in place and ALWAYS abide by them at all times because you're only doing this to PROTECT YOURSELF.  

Dont let anybody tell that its one right way to trade this market....it's sooo many ways to be successful in any market conditions  you just need to be educated on how to execute them when the times are right.

I've been thru more indicators, options flow data apps, discords, etc on my journey as a trader. Whenever I learn a new way to chart, I'll turn everything off just to force myself into learning how I can make the best of it. Even to this day I look for new opportunities to learn this market because life feels amazing as a student. Never allow any trader to promise you a method thats better than others....just trust that they're confident enough to teach you how to see the market just as they do.  My ppl know I like to live and die by Gann Fan and Fibonacci Levels over anything else. But I got homies who style is completely diff from mines and still hit bangers. The ones thats chosen to learn from me knows my brain is always available pick and if I dont know then we will find someone that does know.  Your trading style has to be comfortable and authentic to YOU!!!! If it was one sure way to trade then everybody and there momma would be rich lmao.  Day trade, swing, shares, options, divs bruh it's soooo many ways to eat in this market!!!!! 

Lemme go to bed cuz I'm gettin lit just thinking of another way to get money out this market. I’m getting nice with this ChatGPT shit 😂

I have no clue where prices are gonna a close at what time and by what day. **The Subconscious De Evolution Of Human Life**

@swingshortlong got me on my deep thoughts this morning with her last post but I completely agree with the message. We LOVE the things that technology and AI has provided us with…beautiful thing for the most part only because it’s triggers parts of us that’s susceptible to being programmed to get our engagement. 

Lemme put some 💨 in the air when I say this😶‍🌫️…..unfortunately technology is your so called “Mark Of The Beast”. 🤷🏽‍♂️. It’s so integrated that when it shuts down, the world shuts down. How many ppl still pick up paper maps for road-trips or write on physical calendars the important shit?? 

I still to this day refuse to automate my trading style… @TradeWithCash is a fucking GENIUS when it comes to coding….you hear me!!!! And every once in a while he’ll text and be like “you know I can code that and make life easy” 😂😂😂. But I just can’t because that’s how I build my “connection” with the market. It’s something I have to take time out to study the charts so when data or options flow data comes out for large amounts I for one understand why they are getting in at certain levels and how aggressive the move COULD be. 

Yea all that to say….nothings exempt from technology at this point but damn….do something that makes you think for yourself and try to motivate your kids or others to do the same.  I don’t know how to allow something to think for me….I mean grew up having to hustle so it’s just hard for me to stop, that’s all I really know but technology is slowly reversing the human experience, if you’re from that Pre 2000s era then you’ve know what childhood was like and now it nothing like it….hell my kids didn’t have to learn how to write in cursive in school😂😂😂 wtf🤦🏽‍♂️but these next few generations are cooked against tech and ai. Don’t get me wrong….there are some that’s still able to keep a leash on technology and actually use it to make themselves smarter in a shorter time❤️ but honestly…it looks like we’re losing that race on this side of the world😔. I done did all this typing 😶‍🌫️ because so many lives are being torn apart by technology and some of them will never see it coming ❤️‍🩹

### Post #1538: 2026-01-11 01:43

**Make Not Fighting Theta A Non Negotiable This Year ⏳**

I know everybody wanna be a sniper when it comes to options game 🎯. It’s flashy…you get contracts for cheap and make a pretty percentage off of it but what about when that trade takes longer than expected to play out or when you get in and the price shoot in the opposite direction just explode back to the anticipated direction 😂😂😂

Here’s a theta decay graph breaking down the timeline on how rapidly your contracts start to breaking down. Picture a source of heat and an ice cube 🧊. The Further that ice cube is away from the heat the slower it’ll melt….but if that ice cube gradually get closer to it, the faster that ice breaks down. 

So when you’re swinging options under choppy conditions or too long in the wrong direction this is what you’ll have to deal with. Patience a lot of the times….is all that’s needed in this market 🧘🏾‍♂️

*Link: https://afterhour.com/RoyaltyTradez/beNf/make-not-fighting-theta-a-non-*

### Post #1667: 2026-03-07 15:48

**TA vs Fundamentals — Why Is This Even a Debate?**


Why Is This Even a Debate?🤷🏾‍♂️🤷🏾‍♂️🤷🏾‍♂️

Used ChatGPT to fact check me so I’m not making up shit😂😂

They’re both needed to determine when to buy and sell stocks 📊 The same way somebody who does technical analysis doesn’t really read fundamentals — and doesn’t attempt to — it can go the other way around too. People who rely on fundamentals don’t really look at the chart. They just know it’s a good company based on what they see. That’s a big deal, but it’s not the complete picture 🖼️

Here’s what I’ll say — correct technicals is a precursor to news being available to retail 📡 Certain stocks move off the same catalysts regardless of what’s going on. Healthcare stocks pop off FDA approvals. They pop off partnership deals. And of course, they crash on bad news.

But look at what we just saw with HIMS 👀 NVO terminated their partnership in June 2025 — HIMS dropped 35% in a single day. Then fast forward to March 2026, they settled their legal dispute and partnered again, and HIMS surged 39% in after-hours. Retail traders were shocked both times. I wasn’t predicting the specific headline either way 🙅🏾‍♂️ What I knew was simpler than that — at $15, the stock was at a level where something big would have to happen to move it back up. That’s it. I didn’t need to know what the catalyst would be. I just needed to know the company wasn’t broken and the price was at a level where the risk/reward made sense ⚖️

✅ Fact check: Confirmed. NVO terminated their original HIMS partnership on June 23, 2025 — HIMS dropped 35% that day. On March 6, 2026, Bloomberg reported NVO and HIMS settled their legal dispute and are partnering again. HIMS surged 39% in after-hours. HIMS hit an all-time high of $72.98 on February 19, 2025 and bled down to the $13–$16 range by early 2026 — roughly an 80% drawdown.

Think about it — NVO already has Wegovy 💉 If they’re ever going to make a partnership work, HIMS can’t be out here selling knockoff compounded versions of their flagship drug at the same time. The business logic was always there. A resolution of some kind was inevitable. I didn’t call the deal. I called the conditions 🧠 That’s a skill you develop when you stop letting the news drive your decisions and start letting the levels speak for themselves. Most people just haven’t been taught that yet — and that’s exactly why we’re here 👑

My people ate yesterday off a BA play 🛫💰 I told them Thursday when BA was flushing — “BA looks like a good opportunity to buy here. All we need is a catalyst — a deliveries report or something to drop — and it’s going to move.” Boeing dropped their December deliveries report the very next day and BA moved. I didn’t know the exact date that report was dropping 📅 I just knew the level was right and the catalyst would come. That’s the whole point. You’re not chasing news. You are already in your position before the news drops, taken at a high probability entry 🎯
✅ Fact check: Confirmed. Boeing’s December 2025 Orders and Deliveries report was released on March 6, 2026 — the day after I called the setup on Thursday March 5. Boeing delivered 600 commercial aircraft in full year 2025, up 72.4% year over year. Deliveries are the single most watched recurring catalyst for BA and the most important metric in Boeing’s recovery story.

When HIMS was below $15, the money had already been sucked out 🩸 The stock bled from an all-time high of nearly $73 down to the low teens — an 80% drawdown. Nothing about the company fundamentally changed — they dropped a compounded drug product. They didn’t have to restructure their entire business or break into something different to survive 💪🏾 Their 2025 revenue was still $2.35 billion, up 59% year-over-year, with over 2.5 million subscribers. The non-GLP-1 business never stopped. They dropped one product, kept expanding, and the stock moved. Those were amazing price levels for investors.
✅ Fact check: Confirmed. HIMS 2025 full-year revenue came in at $2.35B, up 59% YoY with 2.5M+ subscribers. The majority of their revenue and profit came from non-GLP-1 offerings throughout the entire controversy.

So I don’t see why people want to make TA vs fundamentals a competition 🤷🏾‍♂️ Technical analysts don’t necessarily know which company is going to be great long-term — we’re just trading what we see. But what do I know? I’m just somebody who loves charts and trading, giving you my two cents from what I’ve picked up over the years 📚

Fundamentals and technicals hand-in-hand 🤝 They shouldn’t be put up against each other. As a trader or investor you should learn both sides — that way you can already be in position for the company you believe in and know the levels to execute.

Here’s the real issue — retail traders are always the last ones to find out 😮‍💨 So what ends up happening is you’re DCA’ing into a falling knife. DCA is fine, but you have to know the levels and size your money accordingly. If you have any flow scanners or options tools, you’re going to see whales parking in price months ahead of time 🐋 The deal got made behind closed doors — on a yacht, on a golf course, at some billionaire retreat. By the time it hits your feed, they’ve already been in.
✅ Fact check: Supported. Market microstructure research consistently shows that unusual institutional order flow and options activity precede major news events. Whale accumulation at key levels before catalysts is well documented across equities.

These two styles of analysis give you the complete picture 🗺️ What to invest in and how to dial in the exact level you want to buy at. Nobody should be buying in blind with no idea of what’s too high or what’s oversold. Because sometimes the return timeline doesn’t even need to be six months. You could’ve been chopped down for two months waiting to go back green — but if you DCA’d at the right levels, you’re out in two months instead ⏱️

### Post #1673: 2026-03-11 12:47 — `$XOM, $PLTR, $BA, $WMT, $UNH, $ORCL, $QCOM`

**👑 Royal Word for the Day — March 11**


Still dialed in. Still dropping the gospel. If you ride with me, you already know how this works.

The week played out exactly how I mapped it.
Monday opened crazy low. I told you to buy the dip. AMAT and ASML both recovered beautifully — and now they’re sitting right at pivot points. The market gave you the gift. The question is whether you were positioned to receive it.
That’s the difference between watching and knowing.

Where I stand right now:
Same boat as yesterday. Be careful chasing longs.
Here’s why — when we gapped down Monday, we never got a confirmed gap up since. That matters. A true gap up tells you real money stepped back in above the level we lost over the weekend. Without that confirmation, every upside move we see is running on borrowed time. That’s when you get those nasty $6-$12 single-day drops that wipe out a whole week of gains in hours.
Take profits when they come. Don’t force it.

What’s on the board today:

$PLTR — Called the 155 rejection yesterday. Caught it off the open. Now sitting at that 149-150 target I gave you. Beautiful execution — but be careful chasing it to the upside from here.

$ORCL — Up big post-ER. Unicorn move. But I wouldn’t be surprised at all if this retests 155. Post-ER volume dries up fast and what goes parabolic without consolidation usually comes back to find it. Respect the move — don’t marry it.

$BA — Still like it. Still watching.

$WMT — Was bullish on it when it was below 124. Better risk/reward was back there. Not chasing it at current levels — waiting for a dip back to that zone.

$UNH — Still looks good. This one’s been on the radar and keeps delivering. Stay with it.

$QCOM — Still a name I trust in this environment. Watching for the next entry.

Oil & Gas ($XOM or related) — Big macro catalyst with geopolitical tension in the background. This sector moves independent of the broader market noise. Eyes on it.

Silver — Choppy. Got to $81, now back in the mid-70s around 76-78. Expect chop to continue.

Mag 7 — Staying away. Market too choppy for those names right now. I want stocks that move on their own fundamentals, not ones dragged by macro sentiment.

The mindset that protects your account:
Cash is always a position.
You don’t have to deploy everything every single day. That mentality is exactly how you turn a great week into a wipeout — one forced trade on the wrong day.
Stay sharp. Take profits when you get them. Don’t be afraid to hedge. And when the setup isn’t there — sit on your hands and live to fight tomorrow.

### Post #1720: 2026-03-27 12:19

**👑 Fear & Greed — I Just See Shit Different I Guess**


What’s good family🫡🫡🫡 this market has given me the perfect opportunity to talk about something most people don’t understand.

The Fear & Greed Index.

When you look at that index you’ll notice fear spikes when the market is bleeding exactly like this. And greed maxes out when everything is at all time highs. Study why they measure it that way and it’ll change how you move forever.

Here’s how I’m wired — and it’s from how I grew up.

Growing up in my environment — when something was too good, you had a reason to be suspicious. When everybody was running toward something, I was taught to step back and watch the whole scene. Because whoever wanted everybody’s attention on one thing? They were moving different in the background.
I carry that same energy into the market.

When the market bleeds — I feel greedy.

Not fearful. Greedy.

Because I’m getting great companies at prices I may never see again. Medium term. Long term. Forever holders should be loading up right now. When stocks are deep in the dirt that’s not a burden — that’s a discount. That’s a gift.

When I see blood in the streets on solid companies I’m not panicking. I’m calculating how much I can get.

When the market is ripping to all time highs — that’s when I get suspicious.

When everybody’s hyped. When the crowd is large. When the news perfectly matches the price action. That’s when my radar goes up.

Why is this thing moving so fast? Who’s throwing large orders in at all time highs? What are they not showing us?
S&P hitting all time highs. QQQ hitting all time highs. But the economy looks shaky. Things are happening in the world. The nation has real problems. But the market is celebrating?

That disconnect is the signal. Pay attention to it.

This whole game is psychology.

They condition people to panic at the bottom and celebrate at the top. That’s how the big money gets in cheap and gets out rich. The retail crowd does the exact opposite — fearful when they should be greedy, greedy when they should be fearful.

Be aware of your surroundings. Think outside of what they’re showing you. When everybody’s attention is locked on one thing — look at what’s moving when nobody’s watching.

The red bag is not a burden. It’s a gift.
It’s not about timing the bottom or timing the top perfectly. It’s about recognizing drastic movement in either direction and knowing whether to sit on your hands or load up.

Stop panicking at discounts. Be grateful for lower prices. Long term wealth isn’t built at all time highs.

That’s all I got. Stay calculated out here. 👑.

*Link: https://afterhour.com/RoyaltyTradez/bkID/fear-and-greed-i-just-see-shit*

### Post #1725: 2026-03-29 15:02

**👑 Invest In Yourself 💯 Morning Vibes**


What’s good family. I’m chilling in my morning vibes right now🫡🫡🫡 if you know, you know 😏

And as I’m sitting here I decided to make today’s topic about betting on yourself. Since we’re all here in the trading space it’s obviously gonna pertain to being a better trader and investor — but in order to do that you have to continue to invest in yourself.

There’s unlimited ways to invest in yourself but the biggest thing is….you have to give yourself time. Time to yourself.

From the moment we come out the womb we’re on somebody else’s time. Waking up at a certain time, catching the bus, school, jobs…we’re born into a world that devours our time away from ourselves. So we spend more time investing in things outside of us and making them great more than actually investing in ourselves.

Investing in yourself is doing anything ….anything that makes you happy and builds you as a person. Your interests. Your likes. Your passions.

You might love your job. Cool. But when that job decides it’s time for you to go — you’re forced to go back to investing in yourself. Reading books. Taking classes. Sitting in nature. Being somewhere quiet enough to actually hear yourself think. Not your phone. Not somebody else talking to you. Just you — having deep stimulating conversations with yourself about where you’re heading in life.

Now bring that back to trading.

What are you doing to review your trades? To see where you went wrong? To see what you’ve been doing right? If you’ve been on a good winning streak — when did it start? Digest everything you’ve been doing in the market and ask yourself — what do I need to do to continue this or to soften the blow when things go south?

It’s not that good traders don’t lose….It’s that they know how to soften the blow when they do.

We live in an age where social media is embedded in the culture. Everywhere you look. It’s so easy to keep people programmed to a certain frequency. TV was probably the beginning of mass reprogramming. Then the cell phone just took it crazy. You feel me.

So we have to take time to step back. Look at some of the things we’ve been missing for ourselves. Start building your personal foundation. Your personal relationship with yourself.

We’re capable of accomplishing anything — but it takes time, work, and effort put back into you. You might have to cut down on that overtime. Give up that weekend out. That trip — well, trips are actually good. Something new. Outside your comfort zone. When I’m out of town I like to sit in a different scenery and from that I can see a whole lot clearer what I could be doing different when I get back home.

The market brings out everything in you.

Trading is built on discipline and emotions. How well you handle both determines everything. It shows everybody’s weak tendencies.

Once you notice what your weak tendencies are in the 
market — you learn to build a safety net. That safety net helps strengthen that negative side of you so it doesn’t take over completely.

Stop losses. Entries. Exits. Profit taking. Every single one of those has a negative side to it.

You set your stop loss too early — you’re out of the play and it comes back and runs 100%.

You’re up 60-70% and you think the trade has more room — five minutes later you’re back down to 20. Then break even. Then -35%.

You buy at the very top or sell at the very bottom thinking it’s just gonna keep going — and then you’re just sitting there like… what the f**k.

There’s a safety net and a discipline you can apply to each one of those situations. You just have to ask yourself — what am I OK with? What is my tipping point? And you want to figure that out BEFORE you get close to it. Because once you’re past that point you just say forget it and make emotional decisions.

What do you need to do to fix that? Only you can answer that. Nobody can teach you how to be you. They can give you the basic guidelines but it’s up to you to take that information, apply it, and really tune it in for yourself.

I’m finna finish my chilled moment for a bit then we’ll start checking the market.

Stay calculated. Stay dangerous. 🫡🫡🫡

*Link: https://afterhour.com/RoyaltyTradez/bkSK/invest-in-yourself-morning-vib*

**👑Fear Is Just Weakness Leaving The Mf Body 💪🏾💪🏾💪🏾**

Yooo what’s good family🫡🫡🫡 

I’m chiming in this morning with a post pertaining to giving yourself 🫵🏾 an opportunity to be the best version that you can be. 

There are no right or wrong trades…just choices being made by applying the data you have available with a plan in place. You can’t have a plan without data and what’s the point of having the data if you’re not even gonna strategize with it…..they just go hand in hand, so I you’re trades have been going against you then ask yourself which one you need more focus on. 

Sometimes we avoid the big decisions in life, self inflicted paralysis simply because the thought of being wrong is just too overwhelming. Fear a lot of times could cost you way more than  just a bad trade…..fear can stop you from unlocking soooo many new opportunities in life. The very minute we stop treating outcomes as failures and start seeing it as collected data😮‍💨😮‍💨😮‍💨shit changes ya feel me!!!! Hesitation is short lived because you fall back on the data to make the educated CHOICE. I’m not the most religious but it’s a scripture that says “Faith without works is dead”. You have to believe in yourself and have the necessary conviction to make the moves. Life doesn’t care about ego….so why should you🤷🏾‍♂️🤷🏾‍♂️ it stops a lot of personal growth. 

Whatever decision you’re avoiding….you gotta stop waiting on the “right” answer. Make the best decision you can with the data and plan that have in place, manage the outcome, and adjust as you go. Sounds reckless huh 😂😂😂 nah that’s how you gain wisdom by experiencing  life’s opportunities. 

Now ask yourself 🤔🤔🤔 where am I frozen at in life because I’m afraid of making the “wrong” choice and what choice would you make if failure just wasn’t an option. In the marines they say “Fear Is Just Weakness Leaving The Body”💪🏾💪🏾💪🏾

The best traders and ppl aren’t the ones that always right….its the ppl that keeps making choices, continues to learn, and keeps clawing forward in life no matter how heavy the mf anchor ⚓️ is. 

Lets continue to elevate family🫡🫡🫡

But today ya boy is. chilling outside enjoying the breeze with a nice one😶‍🌫️ doing a lil pondering on sumthin I can talk about and it’s something we all toggle on and off and it’s Self Control. We can’t control the market but we can definitely control ourselves. 

This market that we’re obsessed with…yes if you’re on AH you’re fckin obsessed 😂😂😂 you can post about the market at 3am on a Sat night and get 30 replies in 5 mins😉 but the market doesn’t give af about what we wish or want to happen. The most we can do is have a set of rules to follow to make sure we can soften the blow when the market comes for your ego. That’s a completely new post I’ll have to right up btw to breakdown trading rules 🫡

You can be in charge of one of the greatest companies in the world and get absolutely humbled when trying your hand in the market. The market doesn’t bow down to your intellect, reputation, determination…..none of that shit. The minute you put money in the market thinking that it owes a result🫠🫠🫠 yep you’re getting cooked G!!!. 

The most dangerous trader and the person that’s most dangerous to yourself is the one that confuses confidence with control ya feel me. Think about an area in life where you could be trying force an outcome, alright….are you adapting to the situation or are you actually fighting the reality of what it is??? Having self control means staying humble and responding responsibly to the situation at hand. If you’re having conflicts with self discipline that means that your mental state is not your biggest priority and that in itself should be a huge 🚩. Instead observe the situation clearly, plan accordingly, take some accountability, and move on without ego. 

We’ve been integrated into a society where we’re held accountable for following all the rules outside of ourselves….so why “CREATE” and heavy on the word “CREATE” because we are the architect of our lives and create rules for yourself so high that the rules to the outside world no longer matters because you see them now as the bare minimum of standards. 

Take a min journal, think about what self mastery rules do you have in place in the world that you live in and honestly grade yourself and see where you can improve and protect your sanity at any means necessary. 

This one’s a bit long but if you’ve read this far I appreciate the few mins you’ve donated to somewhat stimulate your intellectual side🫡🫡🫡. Hope everyone is having an amazing Sunday❤️ rest up because we got work to do!!!!

### Post #1969: 2026-08-05 20:25

**Simple Two Candle Pattern Shows You The Setup And Direction🎯**

I got impatient on my own goddamn setup but eventually it would’ve played out with longer con and the theta wouldn’t have been so aggressive. 

Engulfing candles are one of my main setups on intraday and direction and the rest is just timing and patience. 

So what is it??? Simply put, it’s when a new candle opens above/below the prev candle and goes in the opposite direction of the last closing candle completely washing out bulls/bears. 

Play the direction until the highs or lows are invalidated…and now you have yourself a trade setup🫡🫡🫡

*Link: https://afterhour.com/RoyaltyTradez/btLn/simple-two-candle-pattern-show*

### Post #2029: 2026-08-22 23:01 — `$BTC`

**I’m Seeing Ppl Look For $BTC Possibilities So Here’s My Projection Levels🫡🫡🫡**

If you follow my style of charting then you’ll know I’m big on my “Golden Trend Lines”. If prices are around or below that then it’s time to buy because it’s a ton of accumulation below them before the big BOOM!!!!💥 

Anything under $65k is still and will always be a gift!!!! If you’re buying right now around $77k then it’s a starter position for the move back up to $120k and then $135k.

They just revealed their hands this past week showing where it’s being loaded up at and how fast it’s gonna move once the right catalyst comes along. 

$77k will continue to be the magnet….$70k is a reload spot and back below $65k you throw everything in this mf💰 even the goddamn kitchen sink!!!! Ya feel me!!! 

Don’t be afraid if it dips man and stop buying shit after it goes parabolic😂😂😂 you buy it when it’s boring and ppl start giving up hope. That’s like the first thing you learn in investing…well at least I thought it was🤷🏾‍♂️ or maybe that way of thinking just comes from life experiences 🤔. 

When you grow up without the “silver spoon” you learn to improvise and stretch out necessities to last you as long as possible to get every dollars worth….you learn to improvise to make sure ends meet. Not too get deep but wasting money on expensive shit wasn’t an option when you know it’s a possibility to get it from somewhere cheaper. So I guess carrying this over to the universe of investing….i can’t see myself buying stocks when they’re at ATHs and close to it because everything eventually goes on discount. 

So how do you know when to buy, like my pops use to tell me….if it can be done it’s a book that’ll help, 🫵🏾you gotta figure it out. Find whatever style of TA works for you and figure that shit out G. I’ll do another post on this topic cuz ima make this long af if I keep going about that hustlers mentality but yea🤦🏽‍♂️ $77k is a decent starter position $65k is your buy the dip opportunity. 🫡🫡🫡

### Post #2053: 2026-08-30 15:44

**Nobody’s Coming To Save You Unfortunately 🤷🏾‍♂️**

A lot of positivity on the app and I love to see it!!! I’m prob one of the very few wave 1 members on this app that’s seen it from the beginning up to now and yes….a lot of shit has changed. 

Councilman @Freeballer is doing all the right and respectable things to clear the streets crime but I come from world where situations similar to this falls on deaf ears all the time. 

Here’s the best way the way I can explain what I see…the state builds a nice neighborhood right, put all the right things in place…(schools, couple stores, park,etc) and it’s a beautiful thing in the beginning. Ppl move in and over the few years the ecosystem becomes self sustainable to the point now the people in charge can go to their next projects. 

Some type of bullshit happens and that’s becomes the turning point of what was once something solid and now some of the residents move out and it affects schools because the kids with the 4.0 GPAs leave or the respectable ppl that felt safe in the neighborhood moves out to the next one. All of a sudden the neighborhood becomes just the hood. Shit starts falling apart and it’s now getting degentrified and the ones that care are now at the city council meetings fighting for changes that never comes. 

Me….im the one that’s kinda seen the transitions of this neighborhood and it’s not that I don’t care….but why rely on someone to do come and fix shit when the message has been clear a long time ago🤷🏾‍♂️. Nothing in this world will never be perfect and the moment ppl realize that then it’s easier to adjust and roll with the punches. 

Have I thought moving out….MULTIPLE TIMES!!!! Do I still consider moving at times?? Honestly, yea I do…because of the hood never realizes that they have to save themselves and at some point I have to stop stressing about it because I’m tired of seeing them attempt to rebuild the wrong way. An ecosystem is about contributions, reciprocation, education. 

Yall pinging Kevin and he ain’t saying shit…stop begging and pick ya fckin head up and get back to the market. If you gone be here and you can contribute then contribute in whatever ways serves you best. If you’re here to learn the say “I’m here to learn” then take you what you learn and put it back into the hive mind. The hood saves the hood….SIMPLE. It’s gonna be dumb shit, if you’re one of them ones that don’t get tired of being on neighborhood watch then keep it up💪🏾💪🏾💪🏾. If you have strategies to trade the market then share it, if you have excellent information on companies then let us know…I’ll read that type of long ass write up anytime. 

I always said this app had waaay too many ppl that wanted a handout to the market on this app and it just screamed GOVT ASSISTANCE the more I watched it because ppl thought they were finna get rich for free. I saw signalers hit for ppl 3 weeks straight and take 2-3 bad days and mfs flipped on them once the free ride slowed down at some point the community has to take accountability for shit like that. It’s some over competitive , my shit is better than yours, passenger princess ass egos on this app when they could be contributing more instead of trying to place themselves on a pedastal, then it’s a bunch of handout ass mfs on here, then it’s the scammers. It’s still a ton of dope individuals on this app that can continue to keep this app together..those are the neighborhood athletes and kids who parents gave af and didn’t become a product of the environment but like i use to hear growing up it takes a village to raise a child. The new users are those kids and everybody gotta continue to play the part and stop looking a savior. 

This prob will go thru one ear and out the other for most🤷🏾‍♂️ but once the free ride mentality leaves from this app and ppl actually wanna put in the work to create what yall want from it which im thinking would be a healthier place for all around stock trading….itll become easier to point out the bullshit because how can someone new advertise product and nobody ever seen you around here????  They wouldn’t even match the vibe that fills our feeds.  

Bro the nature of the community has to shift first ya feel me, if yall left WSB why bring it over here. Ppl looking for new updates and shit, learn how to survive with the basics first😂 all they had when I joined here was a port sync and even that’s misleading becomes we don’t know a person did to get money but that was it!!! No images attached or all this other stuff yall asking for it was just simple shit and it worked and ppl thought Afterhours was the best shit. 

This is long enough but if you wanna take ya neighborhood back then it starts with the ppl in the neighborhood and not the ones that sold you into moving into the neighborhood to begin with.
